answers.how: The court is approximately 746 pixels wide, giving a scale of 4.88/746 m per pixel. The initial player-center separation is about 108 pixels.
The white player's center moves approximately 321 pixels between the first and last frames. Multiplying by 4.88/746 gives the displacement.
The white player travels approximately 323 pixels over 4.24 seconds. Converting with the court-width scale and dividing by elapsed time gives the average speed.
The black player's center moves approximately 156 pixels between the first and last frames. Multiplying by 4.88/746 gives the displacement.
